title: How to Choose an AI Content Production Platform
excerpt: AI video tools fall into four categories that solve different problems. Here is how they differ and how to pick the right one for your team.
content:
"AI video tool" covers very different products. Before you compare features, it helps to know which category a tool is in, because they solve different problems. Most fall into four buckets.

## The four categories

**Editors.** Tools like Descript or CapCut help you cut and assemble footage. Descript edits by transcript and is great for spoken-word content; CapCut is a free, mobile-first editor for social clips. They are excellent at the edit itself, but they cover one stage of the workflow.

**Repurposers.** Tools like Opus Clip or Pictory take existing content, a long video or a script, and produce short clips or automated videos. Great for volume from source material you already have, less so for producing from scratch.

**Generative tools.** Tools like Runway generate or transform footage with AI. Powerful for creative and VFX work, aimed at filmmakers and artists more than at a content production line.

**Full production platforms.** Tools like Insturix cover the whole pipeline: planning, scripting, editing your own footage, analysis, thumbnails, music, and publishing, with a brand profile that keeps everything consistent. Built for teams and agencies producing at scale.

## Questions to ask before you buy

- **Where does your content start?** From text, from a long video you want clipped, from nothing (generative), or from your own footage and a brief?
- **How many videos, and how often?** One-off edits favor an editor. Steady volume favors a platform with a real workflow.
- **Do you need brand consistency?** If every output must match tone, fonts, colors, and style, look for a persistent brand system, not just templates.
- **One person or a team?** Solo creators can live in one editor. Teams and agencies feel the pain in the handoffs between tools, which is what a platform removes.
- **How much of the workflow do you want in one place?** The more stages you want connected, script to publish, the more a platform beats a point tool.

## Where Insturix fits

Insturix is a full production platform for agencies and in-house teams. It covers scripting, editing uploaded footage, analysis, thumbnails, music, and publishing, with a persistent brand profile across every output. If your bottleneck is the handoffs between separate tools, and keeping a high volume of video on-brand, that is the problem it is built for. If you only need a single stage, an editor or a repurposer may be all you need.

## Bottom line

Match the tool to the job. The best choice is the one that fits where your content starts and how much of the pipeline you want in one place. Point tools win single stages; a production platform wins when the workflow itself is the bottleneck.
